## What a reviewer should be sceptical of

---

- [ ] PR title is a conventional commit (`feat: ...`, `fix(scope): ...`, `docs: ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; a new lesson-backed rule cites its ID from `docs/LESSONS.md`
- [ ] No tokens, hostnames, private repository names or personal data in code, tests, docs or logs
